title: Agreement Templates
description: Maintain payment, privacy, and terms templates for public-welfare and paid commercial operation separately. Legal pages and the payment dialog follow the active mode and visitor language; missing or disabled templates fall back to built-in copy.
modeHint: Saving changes which agreement set is served publicly. Existing orders and payment flows are not affected.

modeDescriptions.welfare: Free public service with payments treated as voluntary sponsorship
modeDescriptions.commercial: Paid packages and commercial service offerings

placeholders.title: e.g. Public Welfare Payment and Sponsorship Agreement
placeholders.summary: Shown on the legal page hero and payment dialog; keep it concise

contentHint: Basic tags such as h2/h3, p, ul/ol, table, strong, and a are supported; scripts, styles, and event attributes are stripped by the server.
empty: No template is configured for this mode and language yet; the built-in copy will be used.
